rules.title: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted due to owner or relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation are entitled to relocation payments as specified by the Rent Board.
rules.summary_plain: If you are evicted because the owner or their relative is moving in, or due to demolition or major repairs, you have the right to receive relocation payments from your landlord.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si lo desalojan porque el propietario o un familiar se va a mudar, o debido a demolición o reparaciones importantes, tiene derecho a recibir pagos de reubicación de su arrendador.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.exemptions_text: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Tenants Evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are entitled to relocation payments as specified by the Rent Board.
rules.summary_plain: If you are evicted because the landlord is removing the property from the rental market under the Ellis Act, you have the right to receive relocation payments from your landlord.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si lo desalojan porque el propietario está retirando la propiedad del mercado de alquiler bajo la Ley Ellis, tiene derecho a recibir pagos de reubicación de su arrendador.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
